VERIFY_TOKEN.description: A string you choose; enter the same value as the Verify Token when configuring the webhook in Facebook.

PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Page access token generated in the Messenger product settings.

GRAPH_API_VERSION.description: Optional. Graph API version to call, e.g. v26.0 (default).

APP_SECRET.description: App secret (App Settings > Basic), used to verify webhook signatures.
